_note: B33 lycée: school nouns in three natural open-day / rentrée / end-of-year scenes plus a science-bench close-up; English sound-alike hooks acted on each item.

fr_ecole_noun.hook: A little girl swings the big brass hand-bell – 'A CALL!' – calling everyone into school (ay-KOL).

fr_classe_noun.hook: The music teacher CLASHes her cymbals and her CLASS of children gathers round, laughing (KLAHS).

fr_universite_noun.hook: A university student pours TEA from a starry globe teapot – the UNIVERSE-TEA (ew-nee-vehr-see-TAY).

fr_note_noun.hook: The marked papers are tied in a big red-ribbon KNOT, a gold-star grade on top (NOT).

fr_eleve_noun.hook: A pupil pulls the big LEVER of the drinking fountain to fill her bottle (ay-LEHV).

fr_prof_noun.hook: The drama teacher carries the cardboard crown – a stage PROP – for the school play (PROF).

fr_lycee_noun.hook: A senior boy offers the visitors a bowl of LYCHEES – LYCH-EE (lee-SAY).

fr_college_noun.hook: An eleven-year-old carries his big paper COLLAGE to show at his new secondary school (koh-LEHZH).

fr_maitre_noun.hook: The master craftsman measures the little bench with his METRE stick while his apprentice holds the end (MEHTR).

fr_enseignement_noun.hook: The teacher holds up a ship's ENSIGN flag – the ENSIGN-MAN – to lead the tour (ahn-seh-nyuh-MAHN).

fr_etudiant_noun.hook: A student on the stairs beside the bench plays his big brass TUBA – ay-TEW-dyahn, a TUBA-dyahn.

fr_scolaire_adj.hook: The young SCHOLAR in her mortarboard holds up her flask at the school science bench (skoh-LEHR).

fr_professeur_noun.hook: The teacher's beaker FIZZes – pro-FIZZ-er – as he shows the experiment (proh-feh-SUHR).

fr_examen_noun.hook: The practical exam: weigh the EGGS – EGGS-A-MAN – on the brass balance (ehg-zah-MAN).

fr_rentree_noun.hook: First day back: a girl carries a lunch TRAY piled with new pencils (rahn-TRAY).

fr_creche_noun.hook: In the nursery corner a toddler's block tower comes down with a CRASH (KREHSH).

fr_description_noun.hook: A girl describes the caterpillar CREEPING along her ruler – day-SCREEP-syohn.

fr_fac_noun.hook: A FAX machine prints out her university letter – FAX without the S.

fr_education_noun.hook: A mother on a big CUSHION reads to her toddler – a good upbringing (ay-dew-kah-SYOHN).

fr_epreuve_noun.hook: The baking test: her bread dough has PROVED, risen over the bowl (ay-PRUHV).

fr_indice_noun.hook: Treasure-hunt CLUE: a boy finds a pair of DICE (an-DEES).

fr_institut_noun.hook: The cooking-institute chef ladles tastes of STEW (ans-tee-TEW).

fr_test_noun.hook: A nervous boy does a quick TEST while nibbling his TOAST (TEHST).

fr_enseignant_noun.hook: The teacher shows the rings of a big cut ONION – on-sen-YON (ahn-seh-NYAHN).

fr_lyceen_noun.hook: A lycée boy ties his LACES on the stairs – LACE-AN (lee-say-AN).

fr_ecolier_noun.hook: A schoolboy hugs the family COLLIE that walked him to school (ay-koh-LYAY).

fr_scolarite_noun.hook: A girl unrolls a long SCROLL of her class photos – all her school years (skoh-lah-ree-TAY).

fr_elimination_noun.hook: Knocked out of the lemon-and-spoon race, she is left holding her LEMON (ay-lee-mee-nah-SYOHN).
fr_elimination_noun.why: l'élimination = elimination Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (ay-LEE-mee-nah-syohn -> ay-lee-mee-nah-SYOHN).

fr_evaluation_noun.hook: The art teacher assesses a painting of a green VALLEY – ay-VAL-wah-syohn.

fr_classification_noun.hook: A boy sorts GLASSY marbles into three bowls – GLASS-ification.

fr_pedagogie_noun.hook: A teacher builds a PAGODA of wooden blocks with a pupil – pay-dah-go-ZHEE.

fr_baccalaureat_noun.hook: He passed the bac: a green LAUREL wreath on his head (bah-kah-loh-ray-AH).
fr_baccalaureat_noun.why: le baccalauréat = school-leaving exam Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (bah-kah-LOH-ray-ah -> bah-kah-loh-ray-AH).

fr_campus_noun.hook: A boy holds a COMPASS over the model of the campus (kahn-PEWS).

fr_collegien_noun.hook: A middle-schooler rubs the brass lamp to CALL a GENIE – call-a-GENIE-an (koh-lay-ZHYAN).

fr_standard_noun.hook: The school switchboard stands on a STAND topped with a gold STAR – STAND-STAR (stahn-DAHR).

fr_semestre_noun.hook: A boy MAESTRO conducts in front of the year chart split in two halves – se-MAESTRO (suh-MEHSTR).

fr_detail_noun.hook: A tiny ladybird sits on his school TIE – day-TIE (day-TAHY).

fr_sujet_noun.hook: The blue JAY on its stand is the SUBJECT of the drawing class – sue-JAY (sew-ZHEH).
